moment: ONE white new Tesla Roadster at the very top of the tall curved half-loop ramp from the reference photos, a ramp that climbs from the ground, curves up vertically and bends back over itself at the top, held up by a steel truss tower. The car hangs UPSIDE DOWN on that overhanging top section: its wheels on the ramp surface above it, its roof pointing straight down at the dark ground far below. The ramp's thin red edge light and a soft teal glow from the fans under the car (pressed against the ramp) are the only lights. Only one car.
